_comment: Workbook exercise zone-min-oa (docs/workbook/zone-min-oa.md): the lbnl-b59 template's system DCV and CO2 checks plus the system-level 62.1 Ventilation Rate Procedure (ventilation_system_62_1, run from the ventilation section). The data publish no per-zone areas or populations, so each rooftop unit gets ONE lumped zone standing for its share of the building, every input marked assumed (severity is then capped at warn): the two 2,325 m2 office floors (50,052 ft2) split evenly over the four RTUs, 12,513 ft2 each -- the same assumption as the template's oa_floor_cfm 750 = 0.06 cfm/ft2 x 12,513 ft2 -- and the office default occupant density of 5 people per 1,000 ft2, 63 people each (both unverified; the office rates Rp 5 cfm/person and Ra 0.06 cfm/ft2 come from CAMBER's OA_RATES_62_1 table, see docs/VENTILATION.md for its public sources). No system population is given, so occupant diversity D = 1 and the simplified Ev = 0.75: the largest requirement the method gives. Measured OA is each RTU's flow station, masked before 2020-04-10 (data issue oa-flow-gap-filled). dcv_system_verification keeps the template's 750 cfm floor; co2_ventilation_system is the template's. Not run: unmet_setpoint_hours and reheat_capacity_shortfall (terminal rules, not ventilation), and outdoor_air_fraction (no trustworthy unit minimum; see the template's comment). Hourly resample (three years of 1-minute data).
